editorial:
Imagine getting an invite to a fancy wedding on the sunny island of Capri, Italy. That is exactly what happens when Stephanie and Emily reunite for a big celebration with a rich businessman. You get to see gorgeous views and glamorous outfits, but the party quickly turns into a mess. It starts as a fun get-together, but soon you realize that not everyone is who they say they are. The vibe is a perfect mix of a beach vacation and a crime novel, keeping you guessing about who is lying and who is actually in danger.

What really makes this work is the chemistry between the leads and the wild plot twists that hit when you least expect them. The pacing is quick, so you will not feel bored, though some of the clues might feel a bit too obvious if you are a pro at mystery movies.
endingExplained: Everything comes crashing down when it is revealed that the rich groom was actually working with Emily to scam Stephanie. The big twist is that the murder was a staged act to cover up a massive theft. In the final scene, Stephanie outsmarts them both by leaking their plan to the police. Emily and the groom are arrested right before the cake is cut, and Stephanie leaves the island with the money and her dignity.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves twisty mysteries and comedy.
